d.d: A sensation felt on an area of the skin that causes a person or animal to want to scratch said area.
A constant teasing desire or want.
To feel itchy; to feel a need to be scratched.
To have a constant, teasing urge; to feel strongly motivated; to want or desire something.
d.x: He started learning to drive and he has been itching for opportunities to practice ever since.

d.d: To cause to feel an itch.
third-person singular simple present indicative of itch
present participle and gerund of itch
Feeling an itching sensation; feeling a need to be scratched. (of a person, animal or body part)
d.x: My nose always gets itchy the moment I put on my face mask.
He refuses to wear the new sweater; he says it’s itchy.
